description: Language-neutral contract for the tools Corsen Context exposes to AI agents. This file describes the contract only - never the implementation. Every runtime (TypeScript core, PHP WordPress plugin) implements these tools independently and is mechanically checked against this manifest. Transports that serve this contract: MCP over HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0), WebMCP (document.modelContext) and llms.txt discovery.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search this site's public content by keyword and get matching pages with titles, URLs and text snippets. Use this first when the user asks about something on this site and you do not know which page covers it. Read-only: returns content, never changes anything.

query.description: Keywords to search for, in the site's own language. Use the user's words.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50, default 10).

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Read one page of this site in full, as clean markdown with its title, description and dates. Use this after search_site or get_sitemap to read a specific page. Read-only.

uri.description: The page's absolute URL on this site, exactly as returned by search_site, list_content or get_sitemap.

tools.name: list_content
tools.description: Browse this site's public content by type (e.g. page, post, product) with pagination. Use to enumerate what the site publishes when a keyword search is too narrow. Read-only.

type.description: The content type to list: post, page, product, or any custom type the site exposes.

tools.name: get_sitemap
tools.description: Get the structured sitemap of this site's public content: every URL with its title, type and last-modified date. Use for a complete overview of what the site exposes to agents. Read-only.
